title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House
seo_title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House in Ozark, MO
description: This holiday high tea at The Marley House offers an afternoon of conversation over a tower of sweet and savory bites, with your choice of Phoenix Tea Company tea and extra drinks available from the bar. Guests can bring a new toy for Santa's Toy Drive and receive a $10 voucher to The Mill for each toy, valid through February 28, 2027. Seating is pre-assigned, and groups must book under the same reservation to sit together; it is for guests ages 7 and up. It takes place Sunday, December 20, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 802 Finley Farms Lane in Ozark, MO.
